@@ -24,7 +24,7 @@ jobs:
     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
     outputs:
       release_version: ${{ steps.release-version.outputs.version }}
-      tarball_name: ${{ steps.pack.outputs.tarball_name }}
+      npm_tarball_name: ${{ steps.pack.outputs.npm_tarball_name }}
     steps:
       - name: Checkout current repo
         uses: actions/checkout@v4
@@ -68,17 +68,17 @@ jobs:
         id: pack
         run: |
           set -euo pipefail
-          mkdir -p release-artifacts
-          npm pack --json --pack-destination release-artifacts > release-artifacts/pack.json
-          tarball_name=$(node -p "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('release-artifacts/pack.json', 'utf8'))[0].filename")
-          rm release-artifacts/pack.json
-          echo "tarball_name=$tarball_name" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
+          mkdir -p tarball-artifacts
+          npm pack --json --pack-destination tarball-artifacts > tarball-artifacts/pack.json
+          npm_tarball_name=$(node -p "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('tarball-artifacts/pack.json', 'utf8'))[0].filename")
+          rm tarball-artifacts/pack.json
+          echo "npm_tarball_name=$npm_tarball_name" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
 
       - name: Upload release artifacts
         uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
         with:
-          name: release-artifacts
-          path: release-artifacts
+          name: tarball-artifacts
+          path: tarball-artifacts
           if-no-files-found: error
           retention-days: 1
 
@@ -91,8 +91,8 @@ jobs:
       - name: Download release artifacts
         uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
         with:
-          name: release-artifacts
-          path: release-artifacts
+          name: tarball-artifacts
+          path: tarball-artifacts
 
       - name: Preflight npm secret
         env:

         env:
           NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
